rationale: Memory integrated circuits at chip level. The HTS6 line combines DRAM, SRAM, EEPROM (including flash imported as an IC), EPROM and other memory ICs. All current HTS10 lines report No.; chip counts are comparable, but unit value mixes capacity, memory technology, package and complexity. The scope does not separately identify NAND, NOR, HBM, packaged versus unpackaged chips, or fabrication versus assembly/test location.

description: Processors and controllers, whether or not combined with memories, converters, logic circuits, amplifiers, clock and timing circuits, or other circuits
rationale: Processor/controller ICs and SoCs whose principal function is processing or control are not memory ICs.
Amplifier integrated circuits are not memory ICs.
Other ICs without memory as their principal function are outside this study.
Parts that have not become complete memory integrated circuits are outside this study.

description: Parts and accessories of the machines of heading 8471
rationale: Downstream computer parts such as DIMM memory modules are not chip-level memory ICs; this broad line also contains other computer parts.
Finished storage products such as SSDs, flash drives and memory cards are downstream devices rather than memory ICs.
